name: Barbossa's Bounty
description: The most spectacular themed restaurant at Shanghai Disneyland — Barbossa's Bounty is a lavishly decorated pirate galleon dining hall in Treasure Cove serving Chinese and Western food including roasted meats, dim sum and noodle dishes under dramatic ship rigging and treasure-laden decor.

items.name: Roasted Pork Rice Set
items.description: Slow-roasted pork with steamed rice, pickled vegetables and soup

items.name: Dim Sum Platter
items.description: Selection of classic Cantonese dim sum including har gow and siu mai

items.name: Pirate Noodle Soup
items.description: Rich broth noodle soup with braised pork and vegetables

items.name: Soft Drink
items.description: Selection of cold beverages

name: Stargazer Grill
description: A sleek Tomorrowland restaurant serving American grill favourites in a futuristic space-age setting — burgers, grilled chicken and international set meals under a dramatic star-filled ceiling.

items.name: Classic Cheeseburger Set
items.description: Beef cheeseburger with fries and soft drink

items.name: Grilled Chicken Set
items.description: Grilled chicken breast with seasonal vegetables and mashed potato

items.name: Hot Dog Combo
items.description: American-style hot dog with fries and drink

items.name: Kids Meal
items.description: Child-sized burger or nuggets with fries and juice

name: Sunnyside Cafe
description: A bright and cheerful Toy Story Land cafe serving quick bites and snacks in a colourful Andy's room setting — perfect for a quick refuel between rides in Toy Story Land.

items.name: Chicken Rice Box
items.description: Fragrant steamed rice with teriyaki chicken and vegetables

items.name: Corn Dog
items.description: Classic American corn dog with mustard dipping sauce

items.name: Soft Serve Ice Cream
items.description: Creamy vanilla soft serve in a waffle cone

items.name: Bottled Water
items.description: Cold mineral water

name: Tangled Tree Tavern
description: A charming Fantasyland tavern inspired by the Snuggly Duckling from Tangled — serving hearty European-style meals including roasted chicken, beef stew and seasonal soups in a warm and atmospheric tavern setting with Rapunzel-themed decor throughout.

items.name: Roasted Chicken Set
items.description: Half roasted chicken with roasted potatoes and seasonal vegetables

items.name: Beef Stew
items.description: Slow-cooked beef stew with crusty bread and salad

items.name: Vegetable Soup
items.description: Hearty seasonal vegetable soup with bread roll

items.name: Craft Beer
items.description: Selection of local and imported craft beers

name: Wandering Moon Teahouse
description: The most uniquely Chinese dining experience at Shanghai Disneyland — Wandering Moon Teahouse is set in a breathtaking traditional Chinese pavilion in Adventure Isle serving authentic Chinese teas, dim sum and light Chinese snacks in an atmosphere that celebrates China's extraordinary tea culture.

items.description: Premium Longjing green tea served traditionally
